observed_new_behaviors.signal: Xianyu reported more than 1.5 million relatively persistent light entrepreneurs; AI service orders grew rapidly, including AI programming and AI comic/video services.
observed_new_behaviors.commercial_read: Real new labor/service formation, but discovery, transaction, escrow/dispute and reputation are already platform-owned; QA/acceptance products are also emerging.

observed_new_behaviors.signal: Ordinary participants are being recruited to record household/real-world tasks for robot training; data-collector work has become a new flexible-employment role.
observed_new_behaviors.commercial_read: Real new resource flow, but crowdsourced capture, task protocols, participant recruitment, QA, labeling and delivery are already being bundled by dedicated data platforms.

observed_new_behaviors.signal: Multiple 2026 marketplaces expose REST/MCP interfaces so agents can post bounded physical/hybrid tasks, fund them and receive structured proof.
observed_new_behaviors.commercial_read: A genuinely new economic actor relationship, but several exact agent-to-human marketplaces already occupy the marketplace/control surface.

observed_new_behaviors.signal: Cross-border sellers increasingly use AI to compress work previously handled by multi-person teams across selection, marketing, supply chain, finance and operations.
observed_new_behaviors.commercial_read: Real organizational change, but Amazon/Alibaba/PayPal and cross-border SaaS platforms are rapidly internalizing the agentic operating layer.

observed_new_behaviors.signal: Consumers are shifting toward low-price trial experiences, self-service leisure, interest/emotion services and service-first consumption.
observed_new_behaviors.commercial_read: Real demand formation, but local-life platforms increasingly own discovery, booking, payment and merchant operating tools.

examined_formations.title: AI_SERVICE_DELIVERABLE_ACCEPTANCE_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Development marketplaces already define source-code/functionality dispute and acceptance rules; specialized QA for AI/vibe-coded products, deterministic code review and contract-driven testing are already emerging. A thin acceptance assistant is copyable and lacks transaction authority.

examined_formations.title: EMBODIED_DATA_CROWD_COLLECTION_MARKETPLACE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 具身数据众包采集市场
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current providers already recruit participants, define task/scene protocols, capture with phones/sensors, perform automated and human QA, normalize formats and sell/deliver accepted datasets.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_AGENT_TO_HUMAN_EXECUTION_MARKETPLACE
examined_formations.evidence_summary: RentAHuman, Human in da Loop, Taskin, Mundane and others already expose agent-native human-task marketplaces with API/MCP, verification, evidence and settlement. A China clone would require building a two-sided marketplace and local trust/payment/operations rather than exploiting an unowned micro-edge.

examined_formations.title: ONE_PERSON_CROSS_BORDER_AGENT_OPERATING_SYSTEM
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Amazon Seller Assistant and other platform-native AI tools already span business analysis, expansion, advertising and autonomous actions; cross-border platforms are directly internalizing the one-person-store operating layer.

examined_formations.title: LIGHT_EXPERIENCE_SERVICE_DISCOVERY_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Low-price trial experiences and self-service leisure are growing, but local-life platforms already own discovery, booking, payment and merchant growth tooling.
